_schema.purpose: Known (modelId, benchmark) pairs that will never be filled by a refresh — vendor opt-outs, not-applicable benchmarks, scoped-out variants. UI surfaces a 'vendor opt-out' / 'not applicable' indicator instead of the generic '—'. Agent skips these during exhaustive-fill passes unless the user explicitly forces a recheck.

value_shape.note: Human-readable explanation shown in the UI tooltip
value_shape.recheckAfter: ISO date — earliest the agent should reattempt (vendor policy may change)
